name: Water-channel rows (sugar cane)
description: Sand rows on both sides of each water channel (sugar cane must touch water); paths between pairs. Break the upper block and keep the base. SkyPilot reference layout derived from vanilla block-placement rules; it is not a copy of any community design. Check the Garden rules in-game before committing materials.
movement: Move to the next path (+Z by 4)
harvest_direction: Along X; break the top cane block, the base regrows
water_notes: Every sand block touches the water channel next to it (required for sugar cane).
